name: Deliver Thomas' Report
summary: In eastern Elwynn, Guard Thomas sends word of two dead guards and rising danger. He asks you to carry the report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire, where few hands remain to defend the roads.

sections.title: Bad Tidings from the East
sections.body: Guard Thomas watches the bridges into eastern Elwynn, where river traffic meets the wilderness. Aggressive murloc tribes have killed Guards Malakai and Rolf. Thomas has too few guards left to contain them, so he sends you down the road to Goldshire with an urgent report.

sections.title: A Garrison Stretched to the Brink
sections.body: Marshal Dughan receives Thomas' report in Goldshire, where he already struggles to keep patrols on the roads. Kobolds infest the area, Defias bandits threaten travelers, and Stormwind City has sent no reinforcements. The deaths of two experienced guards deepen his burden. Murlocs may soon threaten Goldshire itself, while the region's defenses grow ever thinner.

faq.answer: Malakai and Rolf were Stormwind guards stationed in eastern Elwynn under Guard Thomas. Murloc tribes overwhelmed and killed them as they patrolled near the rivers and lakes.

faq.q: Why is Guard Thomas asking an adventurer to deliver the report?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas has too few troops to spare. If he leaves his post or sends one of his few surviving sentries, the eastern bridges will stand undefended.

faq.q: What threat do the murlocs pose to Goldshire?
faq.answer: Murloc tribes along the eastern rivers are spreading west. Marshal Dughan fears they may reach Goldshire's outskirts within the week, and he has too few guards to hold the perimeter.

faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind City send reinforcements to Elwynn?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military resources are stretched across several fronts. King Varian Wrynn's disappearance has left the capital politically paralyzed, so outlying settlements and frontier bridges are largely left to local town watches and hired adventurers.

faq.q: What happens after Marshal Dughan reads the report?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan knows his garrison lacks the strength to stop the murlocs directly. He turns to securing supplies and armor for those willing to hold the line.
Guard Thomas is stationed in eastern Elwynn Forest, guarding bridges over the rivers between the heart of the forest and the wilder borders near the Redridge Mountains.

angles.text: Carrying Thomas' report shows how vulnerable the Alliance's central kingdom has become. Even roads outside the capital are slipping from garrison control.
As a warrior serving the realm, you see the cost of frontier duty in the deaths of Malakai and Rolf, killed by relentless foes.
As a human, you feel these losses in your homeland, where too few defenders face more hostile incursions.
